title: Introducing ourselves in English
summary: Learn to introduce yourself, say your name and meet new friends in English.
keyIdeas: To say your name, use 'My name is ...' or 'I am ...'.
To ask someone's name, say 'What is your name?'.
When meeting someone, say 'Nice to meet you!' politely.

activities.explanation: We use 'What is your name?' to ask a classmate's name.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence to introduce yourself.
activities.explanation: We say 'My name is ...' to give our name.
activities.hint: This word means nombre in Spanish.

activities.prompt: In English, 'My name is Hugo' is a way of saying your name.
activities.explanation: My name is Hugo means 'Mi nombre es Hugo' in Spanish. It is a common way to introduce yourself.

activities.prompt: Match each English phrase to its Spanish meaning.
activities.explanation: These phrases ask a name, say your own name, greet someone politely or introduce someone else.

activities.prompt: Lucía introduces herself in class. Choose the correct word.
activities.explanation: The present form of be with I is am: 'I am Lucía'.
activities.hint: With I, use am in this sentence.
activities.sentence: I ___ Lucía. Nice to meet you!

activities.prompt: Omar meets a new friend in the playground. Which polite phrase can he say?
activities.explanation: We say 'Nice to meet you!' when meeting someone for the first time.

activities.prompt: Put the words in order to introduce yourself.
activities.explanation: The correct sentence is 'Hello, my name is David.'.

activities.prompt: Sort the phrases by what they do.
activities.explanation: What is your name? asks a name. My name is ... and I am ... can give your name.

activities.prompt: Read the text and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Kenzo says his name and introduces his friend Martina.
activities.title: A new classmate
activities.text: Hello! My name is Kenzo. I am six years old. This is my friend Martina. We are happy in our new school.

questions.explanation: Kenzo says 'This is my friend Martina'.

activities.explanation: First ask the name, then hear the answer, and finally greet Aisha politely.
